device_state_and_mapping.state: binary 6T SRAM state inside 9T1C charge-coupled compute cell
device_state_and_mapping.mapping: plane k stores bit k of all weights; 16 selected output columns in each of 8 planes evaluate together; 128 inputs distributed through isolated local driver segments

write_resources.column_selector: one 16-output group in each plane, same row index; masks protect unselected columns
write_resources.drive_load: 128-cell local write bitline, one selected cell/driver; adaptation to 9T1C storage nodes

cycle_semantics.frontend: T_F includes common reset/input plus array charge settling and selected-column ADC drive readiness; no ADC conversion and no digital reconstruction
cycle_semantics.front_adapter: read_ns=T_F−shared.input_step; this difference is unreported engineering residual, not measured cell delay
cycle_semantics.ADC: one reusable complete sample slot; all SAR decisions inside T_A
cycle_semantics.memory: one synchronous complete 128-bit write cycle captures command/address/data, drives BL/WL, flips/recovers cell and ends compute-ready
cycle_semantics.write_control_substitution: R4: complete memory cycle replaces the one-beat common front; additional task handshake absent
cycle_semantics.compute_memory_exclusion: same state, no simultaneous compute/write assumed; ordinary per-evaluation charge reset charged to streaming

frontend_budget_selection.short: 10ns conditional adapted front; 128 selected physical columns, binary excitation, isolated inactive columns and adequate local buffers
frontend_budget_selection.reference: 20ns=2×10ns; more precise settling plus reference/mux/driver adaptation; single-pole half-LSB 4→8-bit settling ratio9/5=1.8 is rationale, not a characterization
frontend_budget_selection.long: 50ns=5×10ns explicit loose engineering budget; not a statistical bound
frontend_budget_selection.precision_limit: extra settling cannot guarantee removal of static nonlinearity/mismatch; approximate calibrated partial sums only

exceptions_to_common_configuration.change: No R0 count changes; construct independent binary planes from SACIM-03 bitcell; bypass 4-column HCA and replace Flash with shared SAR
exceptions_to_common_configuration.required_resources: 128 selected-column front ends/SAR, isolated input segments, 16 digital reconstructor lanes
exceptions_to_common_configuration.effect: no native four-bit output reuse assumption

exceptions_to_common_configuration.required_resources: no uncharged input reset or extra native ADC

exceptions_to_common_configuration.change: complete ordinary memory cycle replaces shared front plus physical operation
exceptions_to_common_configuration.required_resources: 128 actual write drivers distributed16×8, common controller
exceptions_to_common_configuration.effect: resident timing uses2.2/5/10ns; not10ns ACIM compute

exceptions_to_common_configuration.change: powered static binary state; no program/verify, erase, refresh or destructive-read restore
exceptions_to_common_configuration.required_resources: CIM mode isolated during writes; capacitors reset each evaluation
exceptions_to_common_configuration.effect: maintenance payload=0; no endurance-imposed retry factor
